why: Takes the two panes issue #633 added back off the shared `safe center` + `overflow-y: auto` rule, which is the whole of that change. Neither pane sets `justify-content` in its own rule any more, so this does not merely re-centre them -- it removes their scroller, which is what made `#hud-controllers-title` reachable at y = +21 where it had been at y = -14, and `#hud-levelselect-title` at +21 where it had been at -7 (422x195, the 200%-zoom landscape handset, measured on the built page through tools/screens). CSS is typechecked by nothing, so without this the two class names could be deleted from that selector list and only the named-scroller sweep would notice.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
